mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% over the prior quarter is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS average > 4% over the last quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 5% over the next month predict a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates in labor market weakness.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.5% in the next month
regime_hint: expanding economy with softening labor demand
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive and remain so for the next 10 months without a subsequent UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer demand proxies (HOUST) over the prior 2 months precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as rising orders signal robust economic growth.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between HOUST increases and 20-day forward returns (Pearson's IC > 0.2) in the walk-forward test.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 over the prior month triggers a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing demand raises recession risk.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 105 in the previous month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative only 30% of the time during INDPRO < 105 periods (vs 70% expected).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of FEDFUNDS above 5.25% produce a negative 20-day forward return due to expectations of prolonged tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from baseline (t-test p > 0.1) during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 50,000 in a month predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 return reflecting market concern over job market instability.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive and repeat within 3 months without a subsequent PAYEMS decline exceeding -50,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both retail (HOUST) and industrial (INDPRO) demand indices over the past 3 months drive a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via broad economic momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform a 50/50 baseline portfolio (Sharpe ratio < 0) during the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS below 700 million dollars for 4 consecutive months indicates supply-side constraints, resulting in a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate price stabilization.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative despite RSAFS staying below 700 for the full period.
